text:
steph: hitting a weird one — our client sees valid JSON streaming but occasionally the final object is malformed after a reconnect. finish_reason never shows up and parser chokes on a trailing '{'.

jordan: can you paste the raw SSE lines from the client?

steph: yes. repro steps below and raw. happens after auth rotate + client resume. minimal curl reproducer I used:

```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/stream"
```

steph: raw stream (cut down):

data: {"id":"abc123","object":"chunk","text":"hello "}

data: {"id":"abc123","object":"chunk","text":"world"}

data: {"id":"abc123","object":"chunk","text":"!"}

data: {"id":"abc123","object":"metadata","finish_reason":null}

data: {"id":"abc123","object":"chunk","text":"{"

steph: note last line is literally a single open brace as a chunk. client JSON parse fails. no final "[DONE]" and no final close.

ira: do you see any 401/403 immediately before resume (auth rotate)?

steph: yes, token rotated on the gateway, client attempted resume with new token and connection reused by proxy. No explicit 401 in client logs, but proxied connection reset around the same time.

support-bot: Ticket #INC-2026 created for steph (priority: high).

hamid: likely two things: 1) backend emitted a partial event when connection was interrupted mid-chunk, 2) proxy/keepalive reused the socket and buffer delivered the partial JSON as a standalone event on resume.

hamid: quick checks — can you 1) share request-id from headers of the affected stream, 2) dump the client-side raw bytes (not prettified) for one fail, and 3) confirm if you see "finish_reason" missing in the event just before the partial chunk?

steph: request-id: rwd-20260317-zz99. attached raw bytes (sanitized):

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: text/event-stream
data: {"id":"abc123","object":"chunk","text":"hello "}

data: {"id":"abc123","object":"chunk","text":"world"}

data: {"id":"abc123","object":"chunk","text":"!"}

data: {"id":"abc123","object":"metadata","finish_reason":null}

data: {"id":"abc123","object":"chunk","text":"{"

(EOF)
```

jordan: thanks. can you also share response headers (trace ids) and whether you observed any TCP RST or FIN in client OS logs?

steph: headers: x-rwd-trace: rwd-zt-7f, via: fastly, x-cache: HIT. No explicit TCP RST on app logs, but client shows ECONNRESET in Node fetch at the exact time.

hamid: that aligns with Fastly closing mid-chunk during auth rotation. Fastly can buffer and replay, but if it replays a partial buffer it can leave an orphaned fragment.

hamid: workaround options while eng investigates:
- server-side: ensure final sentinel event (data: [DONE]) is emitted and flushed atomically when generating completion.
- proxy: set buffer flush to not replay partial frames on resume.
- client-side: make parser tolerant of trailing partial JSON by waiting for terminal sentinel or a short idle timeout before final parse.

ira: can you try server workaround: emit a short keepalive then the final metadata event and close connection, and see if it prevents leftover '{'?

steph: applied temporary server patch to flush on final and send explicit "data: [DONE]". Testing now...

steph: patch appears to stop the orphaned brace reproducer. no parse errors in 30 runs.

eng-runtime-bot: tagging @eng-runtime for follow-up. Possible Fastly clipping behavior during auth rotation. See INC-2026.

eng-runtime-bot: please gather a pcap or tcpdump for a repro run if possible; that will help confirm if FIN/RST and buffer replay are happening.

steph: can collect pcap but can't share raw pcap externally. will upload to internal incident thread.

jordan: next steps: eng-runtime to investigate Fastly/proxy behavior and ensure server emits atomic final event. Support will keep ticket open until root cause fixed.

hamid: also adding a runtime check for partial JSON emission in logs — if we detect event bodies ending with non-whitespace '{' or '[' we should log and emit a diagnostic metric.

steph: thanks team, escalating to eng-runtime. workaround deployed for customers on the affected path. will update INC-2026 once we have the root cause. :white_check_mark:
